answer: Each bonded identity places collateral in escrow, and equivocation proofs link identities that sign conflicting messages for the same consensus event. For k coordinated identities, pairwise-linked penalties grow as O(k^2), not as isolated per-key fines. Detection also compounds asymmetric depreciation across the swarm’s escrows, so its aggregate capital loss carries an exponential multiplier; splitting keys among gale, atlas, and ember does not evade correlated evidence.
